**First line:** `C_BASE_URL` (the env var that redirects Claude Code to a custom endpoint) is session-wide, not per-subagent. There's an open, unresolved GitHub feature request for exactly this (`anthropics/claude-code#38698`). Real use cases for a local Qwen/Qwen-Coder via Lemonade instead: (1) a fully separate Claude Code session (different terminal, whole session pointed at Lemonade via `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) for throwaway/private work, not mixed into a real session; (2) any non-Claude-Code tool/script that calls an LLM API directly, redirected to local Qwen to cut cost on mechanical tasks; (3) genuinely offline/private work; (4) `Qwen3-Embedding-*` for local RAG/search, not chat at all; (5) a real head-to-head cost/quality test (Haiku vs. local Qwen-Coder on an identical task, same methodology as video 6/8's real cost tests) as the video's own honest finding, rather than implying a drop-in Claude Code subagent swap.`
